confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, coffee and draft beer anchors rest on 2026 and crowdsourced aggregator figures, rounded to USD. The cocktail anchor uses a downtown-club price from 2021, adjusted against the beer anchor. wine_glass has no restaurant source; it is a judgment based on the beer anchor. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings. The FX value comes from search-result snippets of rba.gov.au pages, not a directly opened F11.1 file, and it is the latest observation rather than a July 2026 rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Harbin-specific crowdsourced price data, which places Harbin below Beijing and Shanghai. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship. Accommodation tiers reflect general knowledge of hostels and hotels in mid-sized northern Chinese provincial capitals.
